items.title: Could They Just Thomas Riker Tuvix? (Star Trek: Voyager)
items.description:
The problem with the episode Tuvix is that it just makes us think too much. So what if they just pulled a Thomas Riker and made two of him? This is an argument I see a lot, for some reason.

You can support the show (and see videos before everyone else) on Patreon!

items.title: Star Trek: Voyager - The Doctor Sings for Tuvok
items.description:
The Doctor (Robert Picardo) daydreams about singing an opera piece for his fellow shipmates. During the concert, Tuvok breaks down emotionally due to the pon farr, and The Doctor improvises to put him back under control.

From the Star Trek: Voyager episode "Tinker, Tenor, Doctor, Spy."
